text: Capital One Financial Corporation, a holding company based in McLean, Virginia, owns the national bank Capital One, National Association.

source.name: Capital One Financial Corporation: Form 10-K for fiscal year 2025 (SEC EDGAR)
source.quote: As of December 31, 2025, Capital One Financial Corporation’s principal operating subsidiary was Capital One, National Association (“CONA”).

additionalSources.name: Federal Reserve Board: Order approving Capital One Financial Corporation's acquisition of Discover Financial Services (FRB Order No. 2025-10)
additionalSources.quote: Discover Bank would be merged with and into Capital One’s national bank subsidiary, Capital One, National Association (“CONA”), McLean, Virginia
